subject: Initial alignment: pen-test engagement cadence, evidence handoff & PO timing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Owen Hayes <owen@redshieldsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial alignment: pen-test engagement cadence, evidence handoff & PO timing

Hi Owen —

Thanks again for the proposal. Before we schedule a kickoff, can we align on three things so procurement can cut a PO this month?

1) Scope/cadence: Your SOW (attached: RedShield_SOW_v3.pdf) proposes an annual full-stack pen test with a two-week testing window and a two-week remediation validation window. Can you confirm the typical on-site vs remote split and whether you anticipate staged testing (auth/blackbox + red team) or a single continuous window?

2) Evidence and data handling: We need explicit guidance on what evidence you need (screenshots, logs, root cause write-ups) and your retention plan. We must ensure you can deliver audit-ready artifacts for our SOC 2 team within 10 business days of the report. Any automated transfer (S3 link, secure FTP) you prefer?

3) Commercials and timing: Procurement (CC'd: Laura) needs a line-item invoice and payment milestones. Our preference is 30% upfront, 60% on draft report, 10% on final report + remediation verification. Can you confirm you can accept a PO on Net30 with milestone invoicing?

If you can confirm the above by EOD Tuesday (11/3) we can finalize the PO and lock a Nov testing window.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: RedShield_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Owen Hayes <owen@redshieldsec.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@redshieldsec.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial alignment: pen-test engagement cadence, evidence handoff & PO timing

Hi Aditya / team —

Thanks for the clear list. Confirming below: 

1) Scope/cadence: We propose a two-phase engagement this year — a 5-business-day blackbox web/app test, followed two weeks later by a 5-business-day red-team simulation that includes social-engineering exercises where allowed. All testing can be performed remotely; we only request a single optional in-person kickoff for stakeholders if you want a walk-through. We will supply a tentative day-by-day testing plan before kickoff.

2) Evidence and retention: We provide: executive summary, technical findings with PoC (screenshots, curl commands, steps to reproduce), timeline of exploitation, and remediation verification notes. For audit purposes we can push evidence to a secure pre-authenticated S3 bucket (encrypted) for 30 days. If you require longer retention or ingestion into your internal evidence repository, we can provide an encrypted archive on request.

3) Commercials: We accept PO/Net30. The price estimate (see attached redshield_invoice_estimate.xlsx) assumes the two-phase model and a one-app scope; additional modules or on-prem appliances add line items. Milestone split — 30% kickoff, 60% on draft-report delivery, 10% after remediation verification — looks fine to us. We will deliver an itemized invoice per milestone.

Next steps:
- I'll circulate a DocuSign link for the SOW once contracts review is done (contracts@redshieldsec.com will lead).
- Can you share any environment access constraints (IP allow-list windows, test user accounts) and a primary Slack channel for the engagement?

Cheers,
Owen Hayes
Senior Engagement Manager
RedShield Security
owen@redshieldsec.com
+1 (617) 555-0199

Attachments: redshield_invoice_estimate.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Owen Hayes <owen@redshieldsec.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial alignment: pen-test engagement cadence, evidence handoff & PO timing

Thanks Owen — quick tech clarifications from AppSec before we sign: 

- Test window: we prefer the red-team window to be scheduled at least 7 business days after the blackbox test ends so internal teams can triage high-priority issues. Please reflect that sequencing in the SOW timeline.

- Evidence transfer: S3 delivery is fine, but we need evidence to be hashed (SHA256) and an inventory manifest per finding. Our audit team requires artifacts mapped to ticket IDs; will you include a CSV manifest with file hashes?

- Data handling: No PII should be exfiltrated in evidence. If PII is present in PoC screenshots, mask or redact and note redaction in the manifest.

- Access & credentials: For the authenticated portion we will issue time-bound test accounts. We need a contact for kill-switch escalation (in case a test causes service disruption). Please add internal contact fields to the SOW: name, phone, escalation SLA (15 min pager).

I inserted inline comments into RedShield_SOW_v3.pdf (see attached) for a few contractual tweaks:
- Replace "up to 5 business days" with specific dates when we lock windows.
- Add clause for evidence manifest + hash.
- Add clause: vendor must notify within 1 hour of any accidental production-impacting activity.

If you can incorporate these and re-issue the SOW we can get procurement moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Application Security
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Owen —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the updated attachments. Laura (procurement) is ready to issue a PO once we sign. Two quick operational items: 

- DocuSign: we received the link at https://app.docusign.com/embedded/abcd1234. Can you confirm contracts@redshieldsec.com is the signing party and that the SOW includes the access/escalation fields Marissa requested?

- Kickoff scheduling: provisional windows are Nov 29 - Dec 3 (blackbox) and Dec 13 - Dec 17 (red-team). Please confirm availability or propose alternatives by EOD Monday (11/9).

Action items and owners: 
- Owen: update SOW to include evidence manifest + hash and escalation contact (due 11/9) — Owen to re-issue SOW via DocuSign.
- Laura: prepare PO (PO number will be provided once SOW is countersigned).
- Marissa/Karthik: share test accounts and allow-list IPs (by 11/20).

If we get the reissued SOW and countersign by 11/12 we can go live with the Nov/Dec windows. Thanks all — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Aditya Rao
